independent_confirmation.method: NetworkX d-separation on valid DAGs with distinct unconditioned endpoints

methods.transitivity: Independent directed reachability; excluded self-queries and cyclic graphs before comparing native labels. Zero remaining mismatches in all five included files. Native labels are never corrected or generated.
methods.d_separation: Ancestor closure of queried and conditioned nodes; moralize induced ancestral graph, remove conditioned nodes, then test undirected connectivity. All 2,069 mismatches include unsupported graph cases; 2,057 confirmed independently on valid DAGs.

split_policy: Native transitivity training file; native length/long_names/reversed/shuffled eval files combined as test. Branching is d-separation and excluded. Identical sorted-edge graphs assigned to holdouts; no fabricated validation split.
